notes.title: Version 1.3 released
notes.content:
In version 1.3 of Bloodwood Dungeon:

* A new colorful character is introduced that may aid the player in ways not to be disclosed here.

* Two new achievements.

* Some typos removed.

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
Players have pointed out specific areas for improvement. This update addresses some of these, namely:

* There is now an additional save spot earlier in the game, just after chapter 1.
* A few characters have been added in the forest area.
* Some minor bugs have been removed.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
* Some fight balancing issues addressed
* Introduced additional character
* Typos corrected
